messages:
sophia_cs: Quick triage — SenecaHealth production usage down ~62% since 2469800000 (this morning). Renewal in 5w. Also flagged a competitor (RivalAI) doing a pilot with their analytics team. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/seneca (metrics/usage). :alarm_clock:

raj_sales: Ack. I saw the procurement contact changed last week (Marjorie Chen). I can intro + grab details. Do we have root cause? Is it technical or strategic (price/feature)?

erin_pm: Noticed low attendance for the enablement session last month (only 4 of 12). Could be adoption gap. Do we have error rates/failed calls? Link to onboarding tasks: https://redwood.docs/seneca/onboarding

max_support: Quick check — our logs show a burst of 401s from their agent pool around 2469829000. Looks like IdP token rotation mismatch. Snippet:
```
2026-03-20T09:14:03Z [seneca-prod] 401 invalid_token user_id=sh_103
2026-03-20T09:14:04Z [seneca-prod] 401 invalid_token user_id=sh_104
```
Seems config-level; rolling back token policy on their side should restore calls.

insights-bot: Usage decline summary: last 7d -62% overall, embeddings -78%, gen calls -49%. Peak calls reduced to 15% of prior weeks. Top active team: analytics. Most recent spike aligned w/ procurement change. (auto-report)

sophia_cs: OK — proposed triage plan:
1) Raj to schedule 30m call with new procurement + analytics lead today.
2) Max & Erin to run technical debug with their cloud admin (auth + SDK guidance).
3) Sales to prepare competitive counter-offer (short-term discounts + dedicated 1:1 enablement).
4) Offer 2-week usage credits while we investigate (CS + Finance ok?).

raj_sales: I can lead the call, available 16:00 PT. I'll ask Marjorie for pilot details and whether RivalAI is replacing us or running side-by-side. I'll loop in their CTO. Need the slide deck with cost/latency comparisons.

erin_pm: I'll prep an enablement deep-dive and checklist. Quick ask: can we share a sample prompt library + operational runbook? Here: https://redwood.docs/playbooks/seneca-samples

max_support: For the immediate fix, ask their infra to set old token TTL back for 24h and we'll re-run tests. I can provide the exact command to re-run the healthcheck:
`curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" https://api.redwood/v1/health` 
If they confirm, I can join their deploy window.

sophia_cs: Finance pre-approved one-off short credits for cases like this; I'll request formal sign-off. Also suggest a joint session with product for feature gaps by EOW.

raj_sales: On call invite — scheduled 2469838200 (16:10 PT) and added Marjorie Chen + their analytics lead + our CS + sales + support. I'll post recording + notes after.

sophia_cs: Thanks all. Assignments: raj_sales (customer call), max_support (auth remediation), erin_pm (enablement + runbook), sophia_cs (credits sign-off + product sync). Will follow up after the call. :thumbsup:
